content.text:
* OTA-WIDE-SKY130 rev2
* Complementary NMOS/PMOS input pairs -> folded-cascode summing stage
* (PMOS fixed top sources, NMOS low-voltage cascode mirror) -> class-A
* NMOS common-source output with PMOS current-source load. Miller Rz-Cc.
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* ---------------- bias ----------------
* IREF (10uA) into NMOS diode: VBN = V(IBIAS)
XMB0 IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=33 l=1 nf=1 m=1
* low-Vov PMOS bias (PMOS pair tail)
XMB1 VBPA IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=33 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XMPBA VBPA VBPA VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=1
* moderate-Vov PMOS bias (folding sources)
XMB2 VBPB IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=33 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XMPBB VBPB VBPB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=5.4 l=1 nf=1 m=1
* output-source PMOS bias
XMB5 VBPO IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=33 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XMPBO VBPO VBPO VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=15 l=1 nf=1 m=1
* RC filter on output-source gate (bias noise x10 mirror)
RFO VBPO VBPOF 500k
CFO VBPOF VDD 2p
* PMOS cascode bias: VBPC = VDD - I*R - Vsg
XMB3 VBPC IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=33 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XMPB3 VBPC VBPC RPC VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=12 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
RPC VDD RPC 40k
* NMOS cascode bias: VBNC = Vgs + I*R
XMB4 VBNC VBPB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=5.4 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XMNB4 VBNC VBNC RNC VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
RNC RNC VSS 30k
* ---------------- input stage ----------------
* NMOS pair (tail 25uA); VINP drives output side
XMTN TN IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=83 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XM1 P1 VINN TN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=60 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XM2 P2 VINP TN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=60 l=1 nf=1 m=1
* PMOS pair (tail 25uA)
XMTP TP VBPA VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=83.3 l=1 nf=1 m=3
XM3 N1 VINN TP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
XM4 N2 VINP TP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
* folding PMOS sources (30uA each)
XM5 P1 VBPB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=16.2 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XM6 P2 VBPB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=16.2 l=1 nf=1 m=1
* PMOS cascodes
XM7 NA VBPC P1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XM8 NB VBPC P2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
* NMOS cascodes
XM11 NA VBNC N1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=16 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XM12 NB VBNC N2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=16 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
* low-voltage cascode mirror
XM9 N1 NA VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=32 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XM10 N2 NA VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=32 l=2 nf=1 m=1
* ---------------- output stage ----------------
XMNO VOUT NB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XMPO VOUT VBPOF VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=75 l=1 nf=1 m=2
* Miller compensation
RZ NB NZ 1.5k
CC NZ VOUT 5p
.ends DUT
